name: Message
description: Secure, encrypted communication between a patient and their assigned doctor.

attributes.name: senderId
attributes.description: ID of the user who sent the message (references User.id).

attributes.name: receiverId
attributes.description: ID of the user who received the message (references User.id).

attributes.name: conversationId
attributes.description: Unique identifier for grouping messages into a conversation thread.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The encrypted content of the message.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

attributes.name: isRead
attributes.description: Indicates if the message has been read by the receiver.

attributes.name: encryptionStatus
attributes.description: The encryption status of the message content.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The type of message being sent.
